title: Credential Scope Regression
content:
Purpose: Credential Scope Regression.

Technical details: A partner's read-only token lost its reporting scope after a configuration deployment. Authentication succeeded but reporting requests returned HTTP 403.

Operational guidance: The incident was resolved by restoring the approved scope and testing role mappings.

Investigation evidence: Record affected services, timestamps, correlation identifiers, observed behavior, expected behavior, recent changes, and reproducible diagnostic steps.

Verification: Compare outcomes against documented requirements. Do not claim a root cause without supporting evidence. Document unresolved uncertainty and recommended follow-up.
